dataset: Relief de la Wallonie - MNT2021–2022, classified-ground lidar, updated2024-01-23
horizontal_crs: EPSG:3812 for API sampling; unchanged local source east/north grid retained
vertical_datum: Subtract the same minimum DNG road source height as elevation-corrections.json. No separate median or roof-derived scenery rebase.
coverage_note: All 61411 points of the existing217×283 scenery lattice have valid numeric classified-ground samples. No missing cells, extrapolation, roof DSM fallback or layout change.
method: Invert the retained local origin and scale at each existing12m scenery-grid point; transform to Belgian Lambert2008; query raw numeric Stretch.Pixel Value from the SPW ground raster. All request/response batches, coordinate echoes and hashes retained. No rendered map colours used as heights.
attribution: Service public de Wallonie (SPW) - Relief de la Wallonie - MNT2021–2022 (2024-01-23). Modified by coordinate sampling, local grid registration and relative datum subtraction.
limitations: The12m retained scenery lattice does not reproduce every kerb drain, retaining wall or bridge. The racing profile uses a denser separate sampling of the same source. Source ground registration is approximately2m uncertain at the OSM-derived road plan.
grid_frame_note: Retained grid XY uses this original geographic projection scale. Materialization composes current provenance scene scale into XY origin/spacing only; source heights and vertical datum remain unchanged.
